extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, policy analysts, and general readers seeking country reference data
extracted.subtask_description: Create concise, Factbook-style country profile entries that cover history, geography, demographics, government, economy, communications, transportation, military, transnational issues, and diplomatic/flag details. Entries should present standardized statistical fields with dates/notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background / Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Background: concise historical and political overview including major historical events, recent political developments, and notable leadership changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a short narrative that orients the reader to the country's past and recent history (e.g., wars, independence, major political transitions), mention key political actors and scheduled/expected elections. Example language from page: 'Background: Angola has begun to enjoy the fruits of peace since the end of a 27-year civil war in 2002.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography — location and area
rubrics_metrics.description: Geography: location (region, bordering states/oceans), geographic coordinates, map references, total area (land and water), and area comparative notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide precise coordinates, list bordering countries and coastline length, give total land/water area with year/estimate and a comparative statement (e.g., 'slightly less than twice the size of Texas').

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography — climate, terrain, elevation, natural hazards, environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Climate, terrain, elevation extremes, natural hazards, and current environmental issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize climate zones and seasonal patterns, describe terrain and notable elevation extremes (lowest/highest points), list recurring natural hazards (flooding, hurricanes, katabatic winds, etc.), and note pressing environmental issues and treaty participation. Example: 'Climate: semiarid in south... north has cool, dry season (May to October) and hot, rainy season (November to April)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: People / Demographics
rubrics_metrics.description: Population statistics and structure: total population, age structure, median age, growth and birth/death rates, net migration, sex ratio, infant mortality, life expectancy, fertility rate, major diseases, nationality, ethnic groups, religions, languages, and literacy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric estimates with date (e.g., 'Population: 10,978,552 (July 2004 est.)'), disaggregate where available (male/female), include health indicators (HIV/AIDS prevalence, major infectious diseases), and sociocultural data (ethnic composition, official language, literacy definition and rates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Government / Political structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Country name variants, government type, capital, administrative divisions, independence/constitutional history, legal system, suffrage, and structure of executive/legislative/judicial branches including election details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List formal names (conventional/short/local), government form (e.g., 'republic, nominally a multiparty democracy with a strong presidential system'), capital, number and names of subdivisions, key constitutional dates/notes, legal system basis, voting age, and details for executive (chief of state/head of government), legislature (unicameral/bicameral, seats, term lengths, election dates/results), and judiciary (appointment method). Include specific election stats when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political parties and pressure groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Major political parties, leaders, and relevant political pressure groups including notes on their status or activity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Name parties with abbreviations and leaders, indicate ruling/opposition status, and mention notable pressure groups or insurgent movements with brief notes (e.g., 'FLEC is waging a small-scale... armed struggle').

rubrics_metrics.name: International organization participation
rubrics_metrics.description: List of international organizations the country is a member of, signatory to, or observer in (e.g., UN agencies, regional bodies, financial institutions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide acronyms and full names where helpful; include special notes (e.g., 'signatory', 'observer') and any important treaty ratification status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation
rubrics_metrics.description: Diplomatic representation in key partner countries (example: in the US) and diplomatic representation from key partners to the country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include chief of mission, embassy/consulate addresses, telephone/fax numbers, consulate locations, and notes on accreditation (e.g., 'the US Ambassador to Spain is accredited to Andorra').

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag description
rubrics_metrics.description: Concise description of the national flag and notable emblem(s), with comparisons if relevant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe colors, arrangement, and any coat of arms or emblem placement; mention similarity to other flags when relevant (e.g., 'similar to the flags of Chad and Romania').

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy — overview and contextual summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Economy - overview: short narrative describing main economic drivers, structural issues, and recent trends (tourism, oil, agriculture, banking/tax status, post-conflict effects, reforms).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize the dominant sectors and economic challenges/opportunities, noting reliance on particular industries (e.g., tourism accounts for roughly 80% of GDP for Andorra) and policy/reform context (IMF recommendations, transparency).

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy — macroeconomic indicators and structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Key economic indicators: GDP (PPP), GDP real growth rate, GDP per capita, GDP composition by sector, investment (gross fixed), inflation rate, labor force, unemployment, budget (revenues/expenditures), reserves, external debt, and current account balance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present numeric estimates with year references (e.g., 'GDP: purchasing power parity - $20.42 billion (2003 est.)'), and provide sectoral composition percentages where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy — trade, production, and resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Trade and production details: exports/imports (values and commodities), export/import partners, natural resources, industry sectors, agricultural products, oil/gas production and proved reserves, electricity production/consumption, and industrial production growth rate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List principal commodities and trading partners with dates, include production and reserves figures (oil bbl/day, proved reserves), and note composition of industries and agriculture. Example entries: 'Exports - commodities: crude oil, diamonds...' and 'Exports - partners: US 47.7%...'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency and exchange rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Official currency name and code, and historical/representative exchange rates (e.g., euros per US dollar with year annotations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide currency code and sample exchange rates with years to indicate volatility or revaluations (e.g., 'kwanza per US dollar - 74.6063 (2003), 43.5302 (2002)...; note - in December 1999 the kwanza was revalued...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Communications infrastructure and usage statistics: telephones (main lines, mobile cellular), telephone system assessment (domestic/international), radio/TV broadcast stations counts, number of radios/televisions, internet country code, internet hosts, ISPs, and internet users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric counts with year estimates and short qualitative assessments (e.g., 'general assessment: telephone service limited mostly to government and business use').

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation
rubrics_metrics.description: Transportation network data: railways (total and gauge), highways (total/paved/unpaved), waterways, pipelines (type and km), ports and harbors, merchant marine composition, and airports (total and runway-length categories).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give lengths and counts with dates, breakdowns by gauge or runway length where reported, and list major ports/airports by name where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military
rubrics_metrics.description: Defense forces information: military branches, notes on defense responsibility (if external), conscription age/obligations, manpower availability/fit statistics, annual reaching-military-age numbers, and military expenditures (dollar figure and percent of GDP).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include numeric manpower estimates with year, conscription terms, and spending figures with dates (e.g., 'Military expenditures - dollar figure: $265.1 million (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational issues and humanitarian concerns
rubrics_metrics.description: Cross-border and transnational matters including international disputes, refugees and internally displaced persons (IDPs), and illicit drug transshipment/trafficking notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State whether disputes exist, provide IDP/refugee counts and context (e.g., 'IDPs: 40,000 - 60,000 (27-year civil war ending in 2002)'), and note any role as a transshipment point for narcotics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative metadata and update notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Document-level metadata: last updated date and notes about data vintage and sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always include a 'last updated' timestamp (e.g., 'This page was last updated on 10 February, 2005') and, where possible, indicate the year attached to each statistic (e.g., '(2003 est.)') to show data vintage.
